integrity: The proof independently verifies the required finite sixteen-point sign and combines it with explicit measure and Fourier arguments. Exact local factor computations at three levels supplement, but do not replace, the unbounded proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Existence only for a countable order-four compact product, not the exponent-two group; singular witness is complex, not positive. The finite-intersection and product-perturbation mechanisms and reversible difference sets are prior techniques; publication priority is not independently established.
title: An exponent-four strongly small-2 spectrum with a singular full-support witness
